_help: Ubuntu: copy to /etc/trygons/gateway.json; Windows: %PROGRAMDATA%\trygons\gateway.json. Passwords go into secrets.json (never into git). Serial names: python gateway.py --list-serial. Check: python gateway.py --config <this file> --check-config
_aurix: the 3.3 V TTL USB-UART adapter (NEVER RS232: +-12 V destroys the AURIX pins). Both OSes: usb:VID:PID:SERIAL; Ubuntu also /dev/serial/by-id/usb-...; Windows also COMn (the number can change)

ais._source: the USB AIS receiver, named like the AURIX adapter

storage._root: leave out = the PC's own SSD (/var/lib/trygons/data or %PROGRAMDATA%\trygons\data); an external SSD: its folder + require_mount true

uav._help: UAV magazine (CLAUDE.md V): false = no magazine on this boat. Each slot = the FIXED hub USB port of that slot (usbloc:<port path>, python gateway.py --list-serial), never the drone's own id; slot 1 = the top one
uav._slots_help: radio = the serial name of that drone's ELRS TX module (MAVLink mode, W70): the launch needs the drone's altitude once its slot cable is gone
uav._hatch_help: U3: hatch_relay = n of the boat's EXISTING relay table (an extra onoff relay, power_up off, no pair; the boat file's "uav": {"hatch_relay": n} too: W57 b, relays 1-7 are used = a board with >= 8 channels). hatch port = the FT232R breakout of the two limit switches (CTS = OPEN, DSR = CLOSED, switch to GND, external pull-ups: W57 a); open_s / close_s = the travel time limits (TO CONFIRM with the actuator)
uav._launch_help: W59 defaults (TO CONFIRM): launch_max_kn 2, gps_wait_s 5, fallback_alt_m 15, clear_alt_m 10, gap_s 15, init_alt_base_m 30 + init_alt_step_m 5 per slot; check: uav_max_alt_m 120, uav_rf_range_m 1500, uav_wp_alt_m 50, uav_land_margin_pct 30
